title: MyLowe’s Pro and Delta Faucet Pricing, Built Into Every Estimate
summary: Connect MyLowe’s Pro Rewards for store-specific pricing and use current Delta Faucet catalog pricing in every new estimate. Available on all plans.
body_markdown:
Handoff now offers two new pricing sources for your estimates.


Connect MyLowe’s Pro Rewards to price eligible materials using your default store’s actual rates. Current Delta Faucet catalog pricing is enabled automatically for Delta-branded fixtures.


Lowe’s joins Home Depot Pro, ABC Supply, and Ferguson as a connected supplier. Delta Faucet is a built-in pricing catalog, so no account connection is required. Both are available on every Handoff plan.


## Build estimates from more reliable material costs


You already know what drywall costs at your Lowe’s because you buy it there every week. Now your estimate knows it too.


Connect your Pro Rewards account and eligible materials price at your default store’s actual rates. That means the number in your estimate starts closer to the number waiting for you at the register.


For plumbing and fixture-heavy projects, Delta-branded fixtures use current Delta Faucet catalog pricing instead of relying on a generic fixture allowance.


More reliable pricing at the estimate gives your proposal and project budget a stronger starting point.


## What the new supplier pricing does


- **Uses your Lowe’s store pricing.** Connect MyLowe’s Pro Rewards and choose your default store. New estimates localize eligible materials to that store’s actual Pro Rewards rates.
- **Adds Delta Faucet pricing by default.** Delta-branded fixtures can use current Delta Faucet catalog pricing without requiring another account connection.
- **Shows where the Lowe’s price came from.** Localized items carry a Lowe’s badge with the product, your Pro Rewards price, and a link to the live product page.
- **Protects the pricing you already set.** Materials tied to your custom catalog stay at your rates, while anything without a clean unit match keeps its estimate allowance.


## Know which prices are store-verified


Your AI Teammate shows which Lowe’s materials were matched to store pricing and which remained at your estimate allowance.


That makes it easier to review the estimate before sending it and see which costs still need your judgment. Materials sold in a different unit or specialty items without a clean match are not forced into the wrong price.


The same pricing carries into your budget. When your[approved estimate becomes a live project budget](https://handoff.ai/ai-budget-tracking) , it starts closer to what your suppliers actually charge.


## How to connect your MyLowe’s Pro Rewards account


1. Go to **Settings** , then **Integrations and API Keys** , and select **Connect Lowe’s**
2. Enter the email on your MyLowe’s Pro Rewards account
3. Enter the one-time code sent to that email
4. Choose the default store for your company
5. Build your next estimate and look for the Lowe’s badge on eligible material rows


From then on, Lowe’s pricing runs on every new estimate.


## How Delta Faucet pricing works


Delta Faucet pricing is enabled by default and currently refreshes approximately once a month. You can disable the catalog if it does not apply to your business.


Handoff also carries Delta-branded products through connected suppliers such as Home Depot Pro and Ferguson. If you want your AI Teammate to use the Delta Faucet catalog specifically, name that source in your prompt or add it to your presets.


**Connect MyLowe’s Pro Rewards and build your next estimate with your Lowe’s rates and current Delta Faucet pricing.**


## Other FAQs about supplier pricing in Handoff


**Does this change estimates I already sent?**


No. The new supplier pricing applies to new estimates going forward. Anything you already built or sent stays exactly as it is.


**What happens to the pricing in my custom catalog?**


Nothing. Materials tied to your custom catalog are skipped during localization, so the rates you set are never overwritten.


**Do I need to connect a Delta Faucet account?**


No. Delta Faucet pricing is enabled by default. You can disable the catalog if you do not use Delta-branded fixtures.


**Can I order materials from these suppliers inside Handoff?**


Not yet. This release brings supplier pricing into your estimates. Purchase orders, order status, and delivery tracking are not included.
